answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The sable holds work receipts rather than names, so the jetty of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
